claim: Games may mirror graphics in place at run time; compare in-play graphics with the snapshot and take shapes from one consistent state, or masks come out mirrored.

evidence.text: Player frames 48-58 are mirrored in place at 43209 when he turns, toggling (43300); a diff of the graphics between frames found 43209.
evidence.quote: Player: 43209 mirrors frames 48-58 in place when he turns, toggling (43300).

evidence.text: The first look's 61.5% byte match came from sprites the game mirrors in place at run time (8F1D); real match 100%: 71 sprites stored the same, 50 mirrored.
evidence.quote: The first look's 61.5% came from sprites the game mirrors in place at run time (8F1D, table FC00, flag in bit 7 of the entry's last byte).

evidence.text: Wally 0xB75C mirrors all 18 frames on a turn and 0xB52E mirrors the spear carrier in place; frame 0 differs from its snapshot bytes in 27 bytes; a census by plot found both.
evidence.quote: 0xB52E mirrors the spear carrier (0xD680, 384 bytes) when his direction (35669) changes sign;

evidence.text: Writing the catalogue's graphic over a state where the frame was mirrored paired it with a mirrored mask (frame 98: 55 mask pixels on the wrong side); shapes must be captured from one consistent state.
evidence.quote: the frame was mirrored paired it with a mirrored mask (frame 98: 55 mask pixels on the wrong side ->
